name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes without distorting geometry, giving us a measurable quality bump on high-res outputs. The trade-off is higher VRAM usage, but we’re already GPU-bound—this won’t bottleneck us further.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under motion, not geometry. RealVisXL locks us into a single vendor’s face tech—if Anthropic drifts or pivots, we’re stuck. Test both on a 10-second clip with faces in motion; if face sharpness degrades, scrap it.
